name: Sasamori Hana
source:
Hana is a third-year high school student. Gentle and reserved, she usually doesn't assert her opinion and easily gets flustered. Despite her shy personality, from time to time she tends to show her stubborn side. 

She got saved by Itsuki in junior high school; since then she's been determined to return the favor in any way she can.
translation:
Hana is a third-year high school student. Gentle and reserved, she usually doesn't assert her opinion and easily gets flustered. Despite her shy personality, from time to time she tends to show her stubborn side. 

She got saved by Itsuki in junior high school; since then she's been determined to return the favor in any way she can.
